subject: Post-call: Procurement & approvals for Redwood pilot
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Miller <jordan.miller@acme.com>, Priya Singh <priya.singh@acme.com>
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 4 Mar 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call: Procurement & approvals for Redwood pilot

Thanks again for the call this morning — great to meet you both. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we keep momentum on the pilot procurement path:

- Pilot scope: 3-month evaluation, up to 100k tokens/day, hosted Redwood API with basic observability and a single model variant.
- Commercial path discussed: PO-based purchase preferred by procurement, payment by card also acceptable for initial POC if that speeds things up.
- Marketplace interest: you asked about AWS Marketplace listing — we can do that but it typically adds ~2 weeks to procurement.
- Key approvals you mentioned: Jordan (business owner), Priya (finance sponsor), Tom Reyes (CFO/signatory for >$50k).

Ask: can you confirm who will raise the PO and whether procurement needs our MSA + SOW redlines before issuing a PO? If they prefer card, we can start on card and convert to PO later.

I attached a short one-page pricing quote and our purchasing instructions to make it easier for procurement.

Attachments: [redwood-pricing-quote.pdf] [redwood-purchasing-instructions.docx]

Proposed next steps:
1) Jordan/Priya: confirm PO vs card and who the PO request will be routed through.
2) Marissa/Rishi (sales): prepare SOW and standard MSA redlines if procurement requests them.
3) Schedule 30-min procurement sync if needed (I can coordinate).

Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0198
[Attachment: post-call-recap.txt]
From: Jordan Miller <jordan.miller@acme.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Priya Singh <priya.singh@acme.com>
Cc: procurement@acme.com
Date: Wed, 4 Mar 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call: Procurement & approvals for Redwood pilot

Thanks Marissa — good summary. A few clarifications from procurement side: 

- For a pilot of this size we generally go PO, procurement raises the PO once finance signs off. In practice we can start on card if it helps timelines but procurement prefers PO from the outset.
- Procurement will need the MSA and SOW to validate terms. Our legal team typically redlines on clauses around data handling and liability.
- Marketplace listing is optional; we prefer direct PO for better tracking.

Internal approvals mapping: 
- Economic buyer: Jordan Miller (me) — owns the budget and business case.
- Finance sponsor: Priya Singh — will approve spend and confirm budget availability.
- Signatory: Tom Reyes, CFO — signs contracts >$50k.

I can loop in procurement and legal once you share the latest MSA + SOW. Can you also include the billing contact for Redwood so procurement has a name + email?

Jordan
Senior Manager, AI Platforms
Jordan.Miller@acme.com | +1 (212) 555-0112
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Miller <jordan.miller@acme.com>, Priya Singh <priya.singh@acme.com>
Cc: rishi.malhotra@redwood.com, laura.bennett@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 4 Mar 2026 12:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call: Procurement & approvals for Redwood pilot

Thanks Jordan — helpful mapping. Billing contact and what we typically include for procurement below:

Billing contact:
- Name: Kim Alvarez
- Title: Billing Lead, Redwood Inference
- Email: billing@redwood.com

I attached our standard MSA + simple SOW template and a one-page pricing quote. The MSA calls out data handling, retention, and standard limitation of liability. If your legal team wants to redline, we can accept routine changes but may need to escalate any uncommon requests.

Attachments included: [redwood-pricing-quote.pdf] [redwood-mSA-v1.pdf] [redwood-purchasing-instructions.docx]

Next steps from our side:
- Rishi will draft a tailored SOW with deliverables and timeline.
- I'll prepare a short checklist for procurement with the minimum info they need to raise PO (billing contact, order total, contact for SOW).
- If procurement wants to start on card, we can enable a card payment and then convert to PO/invoice once PO is issued.

Would you be available for a 30-min procurement sync tomorrow at 10am PT? If not, propose a slot and we’ll adjust.

Best,
Marissa
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: redwood-mSA-v1.pdf]
From: Priya Singh <priya.singh@acme.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Jordan Miller <jordan.miller@acme.com>
Date: Wed, 4 Mar 2026 13:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call: Procurement & approvals for Redwood pilot

Thanks — confirming finance side: budget is available in Q2 for pilot under the AI Platforms discretionary budget. I will act as finance sponsor and will route approval through our AP team once procurement provides the PO request form.

Couple notes: 
- For PO: procurement will need an estimated total and an expected start date. The SOW should include a line-item summary we can include on the PO.
- For contract signing: Tom Reyes (CFO) signs anything >$50k; for <$50k Jordan can sign if we have delegation of authority (we don't for this amount).

Procurement is copied (procurement@acme.com) — happy to join the sync if helpful.

Priya Singh

- Finance sponsor: Priya Singh (confirmed)
